title: Aroha consent record (aroha-1.0 §12.3), ISO/IEC TS 27560-shaped
description: Append-only, hash-chained events, each signed by its own actorDid: Ed25519 over UTF-8(JCS({purpose:'aroha.consent-event/v1', recordId, subjectDid, roomId, purposes, withdrawalRoute, index, prevHash, entry})), where entry is the event without sig and prevHash is SHA-256 hex of JCS of the previous event (sig included), null for index 0. Rules this schema cannot express (first event 'given'; 'given' only by the subject; event purposes within record purposes; non-decreasing at and epoch; non-subject actor must be a room member at the event's epoch) are normative in §12.3.
